title: Flaky cart total assertion
root_cause: Test compares floating totals without quantizing currency; intermittent rounding differs under parallel workers.
explanation: test_cart_total compares raw floats. Under xdist parallelization, aggregation order changes the float error. Fix by quantizing to cents.

proposed_fix.summary: Quantize money comparisons to Decimal cents in test_cart_total.
proposed_fix.pr_title: fix(test): compare cart totals in cents

files.diff: use Decimal quantize instead of float equality
